about: The Offertory of the formulary “Purification of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grace has been poured forth on your lips; therefore God has blessed you for eternity, and forever and ever.

ex.w009: Psalm 44 speaks these words to the king. The Office of this feast sings the same verse of Mary, after the responsory “Elégit eam” (God chose her).
